event_source: frozen top8 2023 I/B/E/S release groups; issuer-date collapse; unique-date blocks

event_window.rule: announcement trading date plus next trading date
event_window.interpretation: coarse daily response, not immediate response

receiver_populations.daily_fact: fixed 2022-12-30 top500 issuers excluding all announcers on date and receiver own-EPS-announcement overlap
receiver_populations.network: fixed 2022-12-30 ranks 9-500 with a frozen PURE_D focal-issuer pair score

company_return: prior-trading-day market-cap weighted across date-valid SHRCD 10/11 share classes; combine RET and DLRET when available
control_exclusions: receiver own EPS announcement on any calendar date from first through second control return date

macro_overlap.window_rule: calendar dates strictly after the preceding trading date through the second trading return date
macro_overlap.pre_specified_sensitivity: exclude overlapping-window blocks containing a focal event window with overlap
macro_overlap.coverage_limit: CPI, Employment Situation and FOMC statements only; not exhaustive

strict_specification: within focal same-SIC2 support if rank and variation are sufficient

inference.block: connected component of announcement dates whose two-session windows share a trading day
inference.interval_warning: threshold only enables a heuristic block bootstrap; it is not a reliability guarantee
